desc: Regulates AI use by healthcare insurers for prior authorization; AI decisions must rest on patient history; denials by a licensed physician.
Insurers must base authorization decisions on patient medical history not group data; denial reviewed by a licensed clinician.
Prohibits insurance coverage decisions based solely on AI systems or software tools.
Prohibits payor from using automated process to downcode a claim bypassing billing info; downcoding must be made or reviewed by a natural person.
Insurers may use AI for initial prior-auth review but may not deny/delay/downgrade solely on AI.
Insurers must disclose AI use in preauthorization; adverse determination reviewer must use independent medical judgment.
Only a licensed physician/professional may deny prior authorization on medical necessity; AI not the sole means to deny/delay/modify.
Prohibits AI therapy chatbots; limits AI use by licensed psychotherapy providers.
Prohibits AI therapy/psychotherapy without a licensed professional; unfair trade practice.
Oversight of AI in Mental Health Care Act; bars offering therapy via AI unless licensed provider; no independent AI therapeutic decisions.
Companion Act to S2197; Oversight of AI in Mental Health Care Act.
Prohibits deploying an AI system that represents it can act as a qualified mental health professional.
Therapy chatbot ban; mental health services must be delivered by professionals not independently by AI.
Licensed professionals must verbally disclose use of recording/transcription software before recording an appointment for AI transcription.
Scope-of-practice limit; AI that solely advises/treats without practitioner-patient interaction is not a qualifying technology innovation.
